description: Source code for the DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher class, which fetches PAC files via DHCP on Windows using the DhcpRequestParams API, including DHCP query handling, timeout management, and script fetching.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Class responsible for fetching PAC files via DHCP on Windows, managing DHCP queries, timeouts, and script fetching.

classes.name: DhcpQuery
classes.description: Inner class handling DHCP query logic to retrieve PAC URL from DHCP options.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher::Fetch
methods.description: Initiates DHCP-based PAC URL fetch, sets up timeout and DHCP query.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher::Cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing fetch operation, resets state.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher::OnDhcpQueryDone
methods.description: Handles completion of DHCP query, proceeds to fetch PAC script if URL is valid.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher::TransitionToFinish
methods.description: Transitions fetcher state to finished and runs callback.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher::GetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Static method to retrieve PAC URL from DHCP options for a given network adapter.

methods.name: DhcpQuery::GetPacURLForAdapter
methods.description: Sets the URL by querying DHCP options for the specified adapter.
